headline: A1-1 - At the commissioned gain, POT-RESP fully CW clips the breath jack from ~75 % of a hard blow
A1-10 - ADR 0006's instrument-absent breath level still comes from the retired 0.437 V REF
A1-11 - The shaper's insertion did not reach three neighbouring statements
A1-12 - breath-sense-link.md still records the R1b dispute as open ("in progress"), and "fifty times" is still live
A1-13 - The "482 Hz" differential pole leaves out C_cm; the netlisted pole is ~459 Hz
A1-14 - The output stage still calls DAC AVDD at POT-OFFSET "buffered"; the netlist has the rail straight on the pot
A1-15 - breath-adc's worst-case injection current rounds the full scale down
A1-16 - No page carries a noise budget for the breath jack
A1-2 - The shaper's "harder to get loud" (CW) and "easier to get loud" (CCW) are backwards at a fixed GAIN setting
A1-3 - The 1.5× floor holds only for a 1N4448W-grade diode at 27 °C; the bought 1N4148W at the bank's own VF limit gives 1.48×
A1-4 - The panel's OFFSET "+" mark sits at the end of travel that drives the breath jack negative
A1-5 - The sensor's datasheet decoupling and output filter (Figure 3) is an unowned open decision with nothing on the sheet, at the layout gate
A1-6 - breath-working-point is DISPUTED, but the shaper, output stage and their sims treat 2.8 kPa as fact and cite it to a document that does not contain it
A1-7 - The analog jack's zero has no auto-zero, an unsourced drift figure, and a datasheet bound ~25× larger than the figure; it dominates the error budget
A1-8 - The output stage's interface row still says −12 V "carries no LED current"; its own body and ADR 0027 say it does
A1-9 - The REF trim band "0.332–0.826 V" uses the raw gain 2.185, the error breath-zero-ref records
A2-1 - Mod jacks: "exactly ±10.000 V" holds only at the op-amp output; at a 100 kΩ jack the range is ±9.90 V and the worst-case span error is −2.46 %, not the ±18 cents/oct stated
A2-10 - mod-channels.md restates the four-resistor ±10.05 V as the live range
A2-11 - mod-channels.md's zero-point formula evaluates to −7.5 V
A2-12 - R-MODGAIN: the BOM says buy 0.1 % thin film; the value field, page, ADR and sim say 1 %; "one reel" contradicts itself
A2-13 - R-PRECISION's "TRIM-GAIN real authority 1.86–2.16 %" is A-grade and unipolar; the ordered part is B grade and the trim is bipolar
A2-14 - ADR 0006 "Labelling" and ADR 0004 "Panel" still describe silkscreen plus a write-on strip in the old order
A2-15 - module-photo-detail render is stale after the jack swap
A2-16 - ROADMAP carries two pitch items the 2026-09-30 changes closed
A2-17 - ADR 0006: "Mod 1–4 … Trimmed" and the channel-number collisions
A2-18 - "Exactly 0 V" at power-on is within the DAC's zero-code error, which the sim leaves out
A2-19 - TRIM-OFFSET span "about ±60 cents" is −72/+60 cents
A2-2 - PITCH jack tip reaches an LT5400 pin through at most 200 Ω and has no clamp; the "check at layout" item is only in notes.md
A2-20 - "At the jack" means module-main's side of J-B2B-MOD
A2-3 - ADR 0006's precision table and its conclusions are refuted by pitch-stage.md's corrected budget, and pitch-stage.md endorses the refuted 0.54
A2-4 - ADR 0006 describes the pre-2026-09-30 trims
A2-5 - ADR 0006 says the pitch jack node "carries no capacitor at all"; C-FILT-PITCH 10 nF is on it
A2-6 - pitch-stage.md: the shelf's frequencies are the 1 nF values; with 2.2 nF the pole/zero are about 7.2/14.4 kHz
A2-7 - pitch-stage.md "exact DC solve gives gain 2.020000 for every load" matches no current configuration
A2-8 - The pitch sim deck models the pre-2026-09-30 reference, not "the stage as netlisted"
A2-9 - pitch-stage.md drawing hangs R-GAIN-CTR/R1 from AGND, not from V_ref

A3-10 - dac-rail's derivation drops I_ADJ × R2, and the sim's "every corner" does not vary the LM317L
A3-11 - ADR 0005's amendment still says the converter's limit is "typical only"
A3-12 - ADR 0004 still states "D-REVPOL qty 3"
A3-13 - power-entry's Interfaces row names interfaces/spi-link as a DAC AVDD peer
A3-14 - Power-down order of the analog rails is argued, not simulated
A3-2 - "A reversed ribbon has no unprotected rail to land on" holds only for a ±12 V swap, not a reversed 16-pin cable
A3-3 - The ON divider is still described as fed from the raw bus
A3-4 - U-REG-LOGIC is still described as the level shifter's supply
A3-5 - NT-AGND-MOD is described as a tie to PWR_GND; it ties to BUS_GND
A3-6 - The module's own rail draw is carried two ways: derived 37/20 mA, asserted 45/40 mA

A3-8 - FB2's sheet note still calls it "THE UMBILICAL BRANCH", at half its nameplate

A4-1 - C-ISO-Y does not give U-ISO 's switching common-mode current the "way home beside the converter" ADR 0027 claims; at 550 kHz the −12 V entry path through AGND_MOD and the star is about 20× lower in impedance
A4-10 - ADR 0027 and the power-entry sim restate the LED row's current with the provenance " owner brief, not yet in the corpus " instead of citing led-row-current
A4-11 - docs/reference/pcb-pipeline.md still tells the module layout " PWR_GND as a trace … a two-terminal net" and prices the star pad "at 359 mA"
A4-12 - The instrument's arriving voltage is carried at two values; 11.4 V still subtracts a Schottky that has not been in the umbilical path since ADR 0027
A4-13 - The LED row's PWM (2 kHz scan, 4 kHz refresh) sits on U-ISO 's input-LC resonance (3.3 kHz); audio-band ripple reflected to the rack's ±12 V is not analysed
A4-14 - The SPI analysis treats DIG_GND as ideal, but pin 8 carries about half the instrument's return; the offset fits in the margin. CABLE-UMB 's shield goes nowhere
A4-15 - On USB power alone, INST_POS12 is dead, so there is no breath and no LEDs, while the LED buffer is live and can drive unpowered LED inputs
A4-2 - ROADMAP's E6, E12 and LED-sweep rows still describe the pre-ADR-0027 module: the wrong ground rule at the layout gate, the wrong predicted magnitudes, and no −12 V check
A4-3 - ADR 0005's amendment calls U-ISO 's current limit "typical only on its datasheet"; the RPA20 sheet gives a range with a minimum
A4-4 - The 13 WS2815B-V1 ( VDD absolute maximum 13.5 V) are the lowest-rated parts on INST_POS12 , and no part holds that node below 13.5 V except U-ISO 's regulation
A4-5 - The load switch's Interfaces row still says the ON divider is "divided from the raw bus"
A4-6 - power-entry-instrument.md still sends the instrument's return "to the module star"
A4-7 - carrier.md's §2 drawing ends R1b at the "analog star point"; the layout rule takes AGND_SENSE at the sensor's own GND pin
A4-8 - firmware/README still describes "the LED strip (one, ADR 0016)"
A4-9 - The "hot-plug at the LT1641's 1.10 A limit, ~0.68 A per rail for tens of ms" rows describe a hot-plug that Q-INRUSH removed; the cases that remain are different
A5-1 - The DAC's SYNC/SCLK edge timing (t8, t4) through the new RC receiver depends on a CS hold time and SPI mode that are written nowhere, and the sim's skew figure understates the cross-edge skew
A5-10 - Two arguments that outlive their premise: the DAC-side pulls justified by an OE that can no longer be disabled, and "a display to report on"
A5-11 - "SPI2 cannot use IO_MUX" is from memory , and the banked datasheet refutes it: GPIO34–37 are FSPI IO_MUX pins, and the design has SCLK and MOSI swapped against them
A5-12 - The "40 mA pad limit" the series-R choice is argued against is a typical drive figure, not a limit
A5-13 - loop-budget does not reproduce from its own derivation, and the ADC and DAC terms disagree across pages
A5-14 - ADR 0001's Consequences still count 18 switches and 14 spare bits
A5-2 - The key chain's hop hold race (QH changing on the same CLK↑ the next register samples SER on) is never analysed; every page argues only the setup side
A5-3 - The firmware contract ( firmware/README.md ) omits nearly every requirement the hardware places on firmware, and contradicts ADR 0001 on the press path
A5-4 - The chain self-test's SER input changes on the same CLK↑ that captures it
A5-5 - latency-budget.md , owner of loop-budget and scan-period , still argues from the two-MCU split that ADR 0015 superseded
A5-6 - R-RX-MOD 's "settled high 2.97 V" puts the 10 kΩ pull-down behind the 1 kΩ; the netlist has it at the cable node
A5-7 - R-CS-PULL-MOD 's row still describes the node before the receiver: "the rail of the part it holds, U-LVL-MOD", against the 74AHCT125's 0.8 V V_IL
A5-8 - The J-UMB BOM row calls the module ground topology "still disputed"; dig-gnd-topology is settled
A5-9 - "Six R-SPI-PULL " is a count that moved: the row is qty 5 since CS_MOD 's pull became its own row
